author: Mark Atwood
text:
Auto-investigation note (anti-pattern-4 sweep, 2026-05-17):

Bead body line 'jmap-mail-types does NOT declare these — grep confirms zero occurrences in crate-jmap-mail-types/src/' is now stale. Since 2026-05-14, commit c90ba4b ('feat(mail-types): add RFC 8621 capability module with URI consts') added pub const JMAP_MAIL_URI / JMAP_SUBMISSION_URI / JMAP_VACATIONRESPONSE_URI to crate-jmap-mail-types/src/capability.rs:16-22.

Mail-server (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs:45-51) still has its OWN independent pub const JMAP_MAIL_URI / JMAP_SUBMISSION_URI / JMAP_VACATION_RESPONSE_URI declarations — NOT re-exports. They are duplicate constants with the same string value, and the vacation-response name diverges (JMAP_VACATIONRESPONSE_URI in types, JMAP_VACATION_RESPONSE_URI in server).

So the workspace state is now:
- Sharing: types-canonical, server re-exports (single home, two public paths — original .16 concern).
- Mail: types AND server both declare independently (worse — two separate constants, name collision on JMAP_MAIL_URI/JMAP_SUBMISSION_URI if both imported, name divergence on vacation-response).

Direction (b) in the original comment ('Move canonical mail's JMAP_*_URI declarations into jmap-mail-types') is now half-done: mail-types has the constants, but mail-server has not been converted to re-export. The workspace decision (a vs b) is still pending; not closing.
